result.title: How Far Can Frozen Vision-Language Models Go on Event Data? A Training-Free Study on EventBench
result.comment: "Technical report, EBMV @ ECCV 2026 Challenge. 13 pages, 9 figures
result.summary: We present a training-free system for the EBMV @ ECCV 2026 challenge "Event Stream Understanding with EventBench" (General Understanding track), which evaluates vision-language models on five event-camera understanding tasks. We use none of the challenge's training data: our goal is to measure how far off-the-shelf, RGB-pretrained models can go on event data through representation and prompting alone. For four of the five categories (gesture recognition, detailed understanding, causal reasoning, and event OCR) we render event bins as red/ON, blue/OFF frames, select a category-specific subset of bins, stitch them into a single grid image, and query the same frozen Qwen3.5 9B vision-language model with a category-specific prompt for all four tasks. The fifth category, action recognition, feeds every bin directly into the organizers' EventGPT-Plus-2B. The system reaches 62.28% overall accuracy across 2,084 test questions (rank 9/27), led by action recognition and causal reasoning (80.27%, 77.22%) and limited most by gesture recognition and event OCR (54.70%, 34.57%). We visualize test samples from every category together with the exact images the model receives, score six alternative representations against the evaluation server, and analyze the full test set post hoc. That analysis shows that our bounding-box crop almost never tightened around content, so event OCR text reached the model at roughly one fifth of its horizontal resolution, and that detailed-understanding predictions are skewed toward the first two answer options.

AI.brief_summary: 一篇免训练参赛技术报告：把事件相机数据渲染为红/蓝 ON/OFF 帧，按类别挑选 bin 并拼成网格图，用同一个冻结 Qwen3.5 9B 加类别提示回答四类任务，动作识别则交由官方 EventGPT-Plus-2B；并对比六种替代表征、对测试集做后验错误分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文直接考察输入表征选择（bin 采样、网格拼接、裁剪分辨率）如何决定冻结 VLM 能否取得细粒度视觉证据，并报告 OCR 分辨率损失与答案选项偏置，可供核查视觉细节保留与证据筛选；但无 latent 状态或推理期动态计算线索。
